svg.text: Figure 1 | Two-track evidence map: what routine cine CMR infers, and what each reference can establish
routine cine → inferred correspondence → defined regional strain
Observed: borders, weak intramural texture, time
Prior selects among equally well-fitting fields
Pixelwise field with a focal deficit; AHA segments
Value depends on reference, layer, peak rule, aggregation
compared per attribute · per estimator · per acquisition
each external reference supports one kind of claim, not the others
reference (solid) vs estimate (dashed); a single mean-squared error can hide any of these

Schematic panels a–c are conceptual and not study data. Panel d summarises direct endpoints reported per attribute (M magnitude, L location, E extent, T timing) in the seven paired or known-motion studies of Table 3.
